texts.facts: The petitioner is in custody for six months and already investigation is over and charge sheet has been submitted against 9 accused persons. It is the case of the prosecution that by consuming poisonous I.D. liquor, total 23 persons died and quite a large number of persons became seriously ill.
texts.arguments: The learned Counsel for the petitioner submits that in connection with CRM No.2056 of 2016, this Court allowed the prayer for bail of one Radhanath Mondal, from whom one litre of I.D. liquor was seized, whereas in connection with CRM No.2145 of 2016, rejected the prayer for bail of one Shyamapada Bera, from whom five litres of I. D. liquor was recovered.
